## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

## Linked Issue
Fixes #(issue number) or Relates to #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD or build tooling update

## Testing Done
Describe how you tested these changes (e.g. manual verification on real Android device, unit tests, widget tests).

## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's style guidelines.
- [ ] I have formatted my code with `dart format .`.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes with zero errors and warnings.
- [ ] `flutter test` passes with all tests green.
- [ ] I have self-reviewed my own code.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation if applicable.
